 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. After Gilgeous-Alexander gave a textbook answer over his efficient 40 points that went in vain, the NBA reporter tossed away any plausible deniability. He admitted in a joking way that he received the incorrect stat using an AI-based search engine. "Gotcha," the reporter quipped. "Don't trust AI." Gilgeous-Alexander delivered the last words of the funny exchange as he walked off the podium. He joked back: "Yeah, don't do it. Definitely don't do it!"
